scope: Audit artifacts only; no production fixes. GCA IDs are local findings mapped to existing track owners.

findings.title: Quad accepts radio Pause assignments that flight does not dispatch
findings.preconditions: Experimental multirotor; configured radio; admitted Pause button; real LOW evidence and explicit resume.
findings.observed: The real quad remains running after OFF/ON on saved button 20. Escape pauses the same activity.
findings.limits: Learned-axis admission was validated, but its runtime edges and custom-key dispatch were not separately executed. Physical SDL, rendered UI and hardware were not exercised.
findings.action: Dispatch supported admitted forms through the activity's selected-source edge contract, or refuse unsupported forms in Controls.
findings.acceptance: Radio button/axis/custom key as applicable; foreign device/generation rejection; held switch and AUX conflicts; keyboard fallback; explicit Continue.

findings.title: Airship retains obsolete native menu mappings after UI role loss or change
findings.preconditions: Native menu map installed for selected pad 7; managed airship callback active.
findings.observed: Registry clears UI role to -1 while native map stays on 7 and Accept still matches; replacement handle 7 matches without role; selecting 8 leaves native map on 7.
findings.limits: No physical replacement device or rendered HUD click. Flight-axis ownership is not shown to transfer.
findings.action: Clear and rebuild native GUI mappings from the current authorized menu role on every activity UI refresh.
findings.acceptance: Loss, same-handle replacement, second-pad selection, changed bindings, keyboard recovery, rendered HUD and return Home.
findings.historical_scope: Separate from earlier managed airship profile/input corrections.

findings.title: Airship Continue does not retry a temporarily refused uncached profile
findings.preconditions: Fresh selected connection without a cached profile; another Store instance holds the V2 lease during first resolution.
findings.observed: Resolver returns a valid profile after release, but same-generation sync/Continue stays paused and unarmed; direct reapply of the recovered profile allows resume.
findings.limits: Cached successful profiles may bypass the failed lookup. Direct reapply is a method control, not an in-airship Controls UI. Home, Controls and relaunch are the player recovery route.
findings.action: Retry unresolved profile state at explicit recovery with current identity/role validation, preserve refusal and show the actual storage/profile cause.
findings.acceptance: Busy-release-Continue, repeated refusal, corrupt/ambiguous profile, changed generation, cached path, radio LOW and verified gamepad semantics.

findings.title: Legacy calibration writers can acknowledge a lost update
owners: direct fixed-wing/helicopter calibration and AUX persistence
findings.preconditions: Two direct legacy writers load one seed file before either publishes a different device section.
findings.observed: Both actual saves return OK; the unmodified loader finds seed and writer B, but writer A's acknowledged section is absent.
findings.limits: A deterministic scheduling barrier is injected into a disposable source copy; no random-frequency, power-loss or V2-to-V2 failure claim. Smoke writer has the same source shape but its pair was not executed.
findings.action: One file-specific authority for load/merge/publication across calibration and smoke writers; validated staged publication and explicit failure/rollback.
findings.acceptance: Different/same-device writes, calibration-versus-smoke, readers during publication, unreadable data, contention and interrupted publication.
findings.historical_scope: Separate from corrected V2 concurrency CTRL-14.

findings.title: Accepted tiny ranges fail their declared normalization endpoints
findings.preconditions: External/imported/manual profile span 0.0000005, below normalization denominator floor 0.000001. Ordinary wizard minimum sweep is 0.5.
findings.observed: Validation and V2 persistence accept the profile; full endpoint returns 0.5. Inverted declared idle returns 0.5 in a ready gamepad reader; equivalent raw radio cannot arm.
findings.limits: No ordinary wizard-generated profile or physical-device incident; signed-side issue is a source-derived extension, not a separately executed witness.
findings.action: Align minimum admissible spans with normalization and activation, with actionable repairable profile errors.
findings.acceptance: Below/at/above chosen bound, absolute and off-center signed channels, inversion, store/reload, legacy import and live readiness.

findings.title: Long-gap continuity needs per-activity qualification
findings.observed: The service watchdog uses an attached aircraft session; separate activities do not show an equivalent no-event long-gap guard.
findings.limits: Focus/disconnect handlers exist. Native sleep or first post-gap tick behavior was not exercised, including aircraft watchdog ordering.
findings.action: Inject a clock gap without other events at real tick boundaries, then qualify OS suspend/resume.

findings.title: Direct launch and verified radio menus need explicit activity support rows
findings.observed: Direct airship uses a distinct legacy route; the shell semantic radio menu router excludes activity nodes.
findings.limits: Technical launch differences are deliberate support boundaries, not automatically defects. Keyboard remapping is already planned under D6-UX-02.
findings.action: Publish and qualify per-activity launch/profile/Pause/menu support and explicit unsupported cases.

findings.title: General no-takeover wording conflicts with accepted quad fallback
findings.observed: The quad deliberately chooses another connected controller after source loss, holds the session and invalidates arm continuity.
findings.limits: Not an automatic flight resumption or a new fallback bug. An armed stored paused frame can retain its mode until first resumed tick disarms it.
findings.action: Reconcile general wording and identify the selected source before explicit Continue.

findings.title: Physical, accessibility, platform and package qualification remains open
findings.observed: This audit's execution is Linux headless, synthetic input and Dummy audio.
findings.limits: No physical Xbox/DualSense/JETI/EdgeTX, USB/Bluetooth/RF, native sleep, Steam/handheld, accessibility, rendered UI, exported package or pilot acceptance evidence.
findings.action: Execute the exact model/firmware/OS/transport/activity rows in QUALIFICATION.md.

findings.title: Measure reuse of a coherent per-device input snapshot
findings.limits: Configured valid default-gamepad path reaching the loops, without extra AUX reads. Counts are not physical USB polls, CPU, FPS, allocations or latency.
findings.action: Profile first; compare a bounded coherent snapshot against identical tapes, freshness, all held-button gates and native input latency.

findings.title: Give setup draft and capture state smaller owners
findings.limits: File size alone is not a defect or measured development cost.
findings.action: Extract one planned draft/capture/lease responsibility behind the current facade with preserved Save/Cancel and activity contracts.

findings.title: Run admitted-action contracts across relevant consumers
findings.observed: Generic action validation and narrower quad dispatch pass separate tests while their integration permits a nonfunctional assignment.
findings.limits: Do not force every activity to implement identical actions or mark unsupported rows as passing.
